author: Sirfalot
quote: You might be able to evade and shoot the cops but the police you can't escape are the Rockstar devs aka the Morality Police. Now, now guys, let’s not be mean, you must not try and shoot the "wrong" groups of people and you have to be kind to your neighbours. Yuk, vomit inducing, I play games for fun and escapism I'm not paying $100 to be lectured and told I must be a kind criminal. REFUNDED.
